summary: VivoPower PLC filed a Form 6-K announcing the renaming of its existing Ordinary Shares as Class A Ordinary Shares, effective June 26, 2026. The renaming is a change in name only; it does not alter rights, privileges, share count, or proportionate interests. No shareholder action is required. The shares continue trading on Nasdaq under the same ticker (VIVO) and CUSIP. This is a routine administrative event with no effect on capital structure or shareholder value, not a special situation.
